question:
I'm building a dbt project and have some issues with the schemas.

Don't know how to edit the dbt_project.yml and profiles.yml so that everything works properly. Right now, I trigger dbt run and get

1 of 4 OK created sql table model landing_silver.dd ............................ [SELECT 1 in 0.31s]
09:39:27  2 of 4 OK created sql table model landing_gold.ddd ............................. [SELECT 1 in 0.30s]
09:39:27  4 of 4 OK created sql table model landing_bronze.prueba22 ...................... [SELECT 1983 in 0.33s]
09:39:27  3 of 4 OK created sql table model landing_landing.prueba2 ...................... [SELECT 1983 in 0.34s]

My dbt_project.yml is like this:

models:
  project:
    00_landing:
      +schema: landing
      +materialized: table
    01_bronze:
      +schema: bronze      
      +materialized: table
    02_silver:
      +schema: silver      
      +materialized: table
    03_gold:
      +schema: gold        
      +materialized: table

And this is the profiles.yml:

dbt_ibercaja:             # Debe coincidir con el "profile" de dbt_project.yml
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:

      .......

      schema: landing  
      
      .......

Thanks in advance
title: Issues with dbt schemas and models
answer:
The schema in your dbt_project.yml is a "custom schema" and that's the default behaviour, your profiles.yml schema is a prefix added to your custom schema. The final schema used is defined as <target_schema>_<custom_schema>

dbt has an explanation about Custom schemas, they also explain how you can change the default behavior using a macro, in case you need more custom changes.
